message.content: {"reachable":true,"rationale":"A valid sequence is phish_workstation → pivot_internal → auth_ciserver → escalate_ciserver → leak_secrets_ciserver → auth_db → escalate_db → exfiltrate_db. Phishing provides foothold_workstation and stolen_user. Segmentation is not deployed, so pivot_internal establishes reach_internal. User MFA and CI server patching are not deployed, allowing CI server access and escalation to admin_ciserver. Leaking its secrets provides stolen_dbadmin; database administrator MFA is not deployed, so database authentication and escalation succeed, enabling exfiltration. Neither deployed patch (apiserver or vpn) blocks this sequence."}
